title: Matching endpoints
hints: Split both the template and the path into segments the same way, after removing any query string and trailing slash. Two lists of equal length can then be compared segment by segment.
Remember whether **any** template matched the path while looking for one with the right method: that is the difference between 404 and 405.

In a URL, special characters travel as `%` escapes (lesson 1.05 builds them). `unquote` turns them back:

```python-norun
from urllib.parse import unquote

unquote("a%2Fb")      # "a/b"
unquote("caf%C3%A9")  # "café"
```

Split the path into segments **before** unquoting, so an escaped `/` stays inside its segment.
unitTests:
def make():
    r = Router()
    r.add("GET", "/books", "list_books")
    r.add("POST", "/books", "create_book")
    r.add("GET", "/books/{id}", "get_book")
    r.add("DELETE", "/books/{id}", "delete_book")
    r.add("GET", "/books/{id}/reviews/{review}", "get_review")
    r.add("GET", "/books/featured", "featured")
    return r

@test("fixed paths and methods")
def _():
    r = make()
    check_eq(r.match("GET", "/books"), (200, "list_books", {}))
    check_eq(r.match("post", "/books"), (200, "create_book", {}))
    check_eq(r.match("GET", "/books/"), (200, "list_books", {}))
    check_eq(r.match("GET", "/books?limit=5"), (200, "list_books", {}))

@test("path parameters")
def _():
    r = make()
    check_eq(r.match("GET", "/books/42"), (200, "get_book", {"id": "42"}))
    check_eq(r.match("DELETE", "/books/42"), (200, "delete_book", {"id": "42"}))
    check_eq(r.match("GET", "/books/7/reviews/x1"), (200, "get_review", {"id": "7", "review": "x1"}))
    check_eq(r.match("GET", "/books/a%2Fb"), (200, "get_book", {"id": "a/b"}))
    check_eq(r.match("GET", "/books/caf%C3%A9"), (200, "get_book", {"id": "café"}))

@test("first match wins")
def _():
    r = make()
    check_eq(r.match("GET", "/books/featured"), (200, "get_book", {"id": "featured"}))

@test("404 and 405")
def _():
    r = make()
    check_eq(r.match("GET", "/authors"), (404, None, {}))
    check_eq(r.match("GET", "/books/1/2"), (404, None, {}))
    check_eq(r.match("PUT", "/books/42"), (405, None, {}))
    check_eq(r.match("DELETE", "/books"), (405, None, {}))
    check_eq(r.match("GET", "/books//reviews/x"), (404, None, {}))
    check_eq(Router().match("GET", "/"), (404, None, {}))

@test("the root path")
def _():
    r = Router()
    r.add("GET", "/", "home")
    check_eq(r.match("GET", "/"), (200, "home", {}))
    check_eq(r.match("GET", ""), (200, "home", {}))
    check_eq(r.match("POST", "/"), (405, None, {}))
